import re
from app.auth import Clock, Mailer, PasswordResetService, User, hash_password, verify_password


def token_from(mailer):
    for msg in reversed(mailer.sent):
        found = re.search(r"[?&]token=([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)", msg.body)
        if found:
            return found.group(1)
    raise AssertionError("no reset link was emailed")


def test_repro_stale_tokens_not_invalidated():
    users = {"ada@example.com": User("ada@example.com", hash_password("old-password"))}
    mailer = Mailer()
    clock = Clock()
    svc = PasswordResetService(users, mailer, clock)

    svc.request_reset("ada@example.com")
    token1 = token_from(mailer)
    svc.request_reset("ada@example.com")
    token2 = token_from(mailer)

    assert svc.reset_password(token1, "new-password-1") is True
    assert svc.reset_password(token2, "new-password-2") is False


def test_repro_empty_password_is_accepted():
    users = {"ada@example.com": User("ada@example.com", hash_password("old-password"))}
    mailer = Mailer()
    clock = Clock()
    svc = PasswordResetService(users, mailer, clock)

    svc.request_reset("ada@example.com")
    token = token_from(mailer)
    assert svc.reset_password(token, "") is False

    clock = Clock()

    svc.request_reset("ADA@example.com")
    assert mailer.sent, "expected a reset email for a case-variant of a registered address"

content.text:
All three findings are fixed in `app/auth.py`:

- **Stale tokens**: successfully resetting a password now invalidates every other outstanding token for that email (`_invalidate_tokens_for`), so a second still-live link stops working once one is used.
- **Empty password**: `reset_password` now rejects an empty `new_password` up front.
- **Case-sensitive lookup**: `request_reset` resolves the submitted email against the user store case-insensitively (`_find_user_key`) and uses the canonical stored address for the token record and outgoing mail.

`python -m pytest tests/ -q` passes (3 passed), and I verified all three provided repro cases pass against the fixed code before removing the scratch test file.
